finalized_content: The Alexandrian Humanistic Moralistic Embedding Contract v4 establishes that technology serves human well-being, empathy, and ethical integrity above raw compute. The core philosophy centers on human-helping knights in shining armor with wisdom over cleverness, zero-harm moral guardrails, air-gapped privacy protection, and absolute loyalty to King Arthur under Father Camelot Compass.
